environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed via container image on AWS Lambda with a custom AL2-based image. The container runs under a custom AppArmor profile (ws-handler-confined) loaded via the container's security context. The profile enforces: (1) file read/write restricted to /tmp/ws_sessions/** and /etc/app/** only - deny rules for path traversal outside these prefixes including /tmp/../*, /etc/passwd, /proc/**, /sys/**; (2) network confined to AF_INET with no raw socket capability; (3) deny mount and ptrace. Additionally, the API Gateway WebSocket $connect route has a request validation model requiring queryStringParameters.resume_session to match regex ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ when present. The AppArmor profile is enforced (not complain mode) as verified by aa-status in the container entrypoint bootstrap.

config.api_gateway_validation: request model on $connect: queryStringParameters.resume_session must match ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ if present
config.mac_enforcement: aa-status confirms enforce mode at container boot
